subject: cursor paging handler
description: Implement GET /tasks cursor paging in src/server.js per decided plan #19 (proposal 95beccba5f70): createdAt DESC, id DESC; opaque base64url {createdAt,id} cursor; limit default 20 max 50; {items, nextCursor}; past-end cursor → empty page; malformed cursor (e.g. after=zzz) → 400 not 500. Open: limit>50 clamp vs 400. (req #21 by alice)
